answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the ledge graph. Re-attestations are stored in pearl and voyage lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 197 impostors cost 624 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
